authority: All three pages jointly define the hackathon rubric; external company information supplements factual checks, not score definitions.

resolved_by_document.topic: No means required action omitted/wrong; N/A means configured non-applicability
04 has five defined steps and can credit an appropriate next step
06 has defined 10/7/4/0 conditions; an incomplete consultation does not itself imply unclear dialogue
General tariff question needs no identification; required but unconfirmed verification means No
Evidence may be a replica or system event; missing actions need the location where expected; N/A needs its condition
A private paid-service offer is enough for 08; agreement/payment is not necessary
First-reaction three-minute threshold, tags and attachments are excluded
Weighted scale calculation, N/A redistribution and final two-decimal rounding

diagnostic_focus: Test whether each selected step satisfies its already defined condition in the actual transcript. Do not treat every difficult application as a missing rule or import stricter rules from the internet.
remaining_application_questions: Whether a particular escalation has enough context to qualify as the correct next step
Whether the operator's response addresses the specific inconvenience under the exact empathy wording
Whether the transcript evidences a clarification caused by unclear communication versus repetition of a known fact
Whether missing closing text reflects an omitted action or a supported interruption
